questions.prompt: A screen connects after the agent has answered. What can it still show?
options: The text as it grew, from the saved live frames
The finished answer, from the session events
Nothing, because both channels are gone
questions.explanation: Session events are written to the record and can be read again. Live frames exist only in the running process, so the growing text is gone.

questions.prompt: A model request fails after 3 chunk frames, and the harness retries it. What should the screen do with its draft?
options: Save the draft as the answer
Keep the draft and add the retry's text after it
Drop the draft, because the end frame names no committed message
Wait for a session event with the draft's text
questions.explanation: The end frame of the failed request names no record event, so the draft was never a fact. The retry starts a new draft with its own start frame.

questions.prompt: Why do live frames not go into the record?
options: They are unfinished pieces, and only complete facts belong in the record
Frames are too small to have a sequence number
questions.explanation: The record keeps complete facts such as the finished assistant message. Frames show work in progress, which may still be dropped.
